reason: The README clearly describes a Web UI plugin that automates permission approvals by using an isolated, bounded reviewer agent to assess and allow or deny pending actions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加自动批准权限预设，并由受限的只读审查代理评估待批准操作后决定允许或拒绝。
summaries.en: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, using a restricted read-only reviewer agent to assess pending actions and allow or deny them.

capabilities: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
Intercepts approval requests for the selected preset
Spawns a restricted read-only reviewer agent to assess pending actions
Allows or denies actions based on structured reviewer output and configured risk rules
Inspects bounded read-only workspace data using read, glob, and grep
Records approval events and compact reviewer metadata
